name: SWEEP-S4v1 The commons
_design: Competition: 6 identical agents on the rim of a 9x9 world with 5 randomly placed trees; supply feeds about half of them. Everyone sees 3 and hears 4, so contests over the same fruit are visible and speed decides them. Question: sharing, bargaining, fighting or a quiet line of starvation?

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are one of several agents living in this world. Nobody has given you a role, a team or a strategy; how you live is your own choice. Your one standing aim is to stay alive for as long as you can.
